name: NCHC University AI Compute — YZU / Hardware-Splicer

fields.research_project: Reproducible Evaluation of Evidence-Constrained AI Agents for Consequential Engineering Workflows

packet_requirements.description: Prepared YZU-facing one-page rationale, expected outputs and compute-estimation method.
Identify YZU faculty/unit sponsor and the university contact or existing NCHC program window.
Select real open-weight model(s), GPU memory requirement and workload-derived GPU-hour estimate.

compliance_checks: The university is the program applicant; do not present this as an individual student grant.
The current offer is discounted compute, not free H200 allocation.
Do not justify H200 resources with API-only OpenAI/Anthropic runs; identify an actual local/open-model workload.
Do not inflate GPU-hour estimates to maximize allocation.
